results.content:
Title: Open-Source Email Client & App with AI | Inbox Zero
NEW: THE INBOX ZERO EMAIL CLIENT. # Fly through your inbox.AI does the rest. Free to use and open source, on web, desktop and iPhone. Add AI to sort every email and draft replies in your voice, for half the price of Superhuman. ## An email client that keeps up with you. Every action has a shortcut, so you can clear your inbox without reaching for the mouse. Your inbox is split by what needs you. AI labels every email as it arrives and splits your inbox into tabs like To Reply, Newsletter, and Calendar. When an email needs a reply, a draft is already waiting, written in your style with context from your past emails and calendar. ## One email app for every account, and your team. ### Every account in one inbox. ### Open source, in the open. The web and desktop email client is open source under the AGPL license. The open-source AI email client and assistant. Use the email client in your browser, in thedesktop apps for Mac and Windows, or in the native iPhone app. Is Inbox Zero an email client? :   Yes. Inbox Zero is an email client for the web, Mac, Windows, and iPhone. Is there an open-source email client with AI? :   Yes. The Inbox Zero email client for web and desktop is open source under the AGPL license, with AI labels and drafts built in. You can read the code on GitHub. The iPhone app is a separate app and is not open source. :   If you want a keyboard-first email client with AI built in, Inbox Zero is made for Gmail and Google Workspace, as well as Outlook. It gives you a split inbox, AI labels, replies drafted in your voice, and all your accounts in one place. The email app is free to use. Does the AI draft a reply to every email? :   Inbox Zero is an open-source alternative to Superhuman for Gmail and Outlook, with AI drafts, a split inbox, and team comments built in. Is the email app free? :   Yes. The email app is free to use.

results.content:
Title: Zero: AI Native Email Client | Product Hunt
# Zero. ## AI Native Email Client. ## AI Native Email Client. Zero was ranked #2 of the week for May 27th, 2025. Zero was ranked #1 of the day for May 27th, 2025. ### Engineering & Development. ### LLMs. ### Productivity. ### Marketing & Sales. ### Design & Creative. ### Social & Community. ### Finance. ### AI Agents. ### Trending categories. ### Top reviewed. ### Trending products. ### Top forum threads. As a potential user, I have a suggestion: to put somewhere on the landing page that it works with Gmail. That would clear so many questions in an instant. But seems very interesting, I like that you emphasize the fast UI (Gmail is very slow). I'll try it out. @zot Does it work ***only*** with Gmail? @zot  @aloizzie Unfortunately it appears to only be gmail right now. This is the most annoying thing about potentially exciting new email clients... they all launch with gmail only support and outlook or other support promised as "coming soon", which generally takes a year or never. @manuarora the king of ui is here! Congrats on the launch, I have been following Zero from the beginning and you've been doing amazing work so far. Future is bright for emails ☀️. The UI looks really stunning and professional :). Does Zero have an app? it's on the way! Not me thinking set up was going to take all day... that was literally the easiest onboarding I've experienced. Now I just want a Clippy-like figure to chat with that can tell me to stop subscribing to newsletters I don't read. The story of this going from 0 (lol) to 1 was super interesting. A great example of building in public, from problem to idea right through to launch. It's open source too. I'm hoping for an iOS launch in the near future. @oliver\_coleshill Thank you Oliver. It's in the works!
